messages.subject: Error during FragmentLengthNormalization (fln)
parts:
I am repeatedly receiving errors while processing
FragmentLengthNormalization while performing a modified version of the
CRMAv2 analysis. Output is shown below. A quick search of the forum
revealed a thread describing a similar problem (specifically with
GenomeWideSNP_5) which was resolved by patching/updating the relevant
packages. As All my packages are up-to-date, I am at a loss as to
what the problem might be.
